book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Yesu kangualaghila Ahundwa bhake kumi na abhili
Yesu kakiakema bhala ahundwa bhake kumi na abhili, kakiapegha makalama gha kughabhingabhinga mandilu na kulamiha matamwa ghoha.
Agha ndo mahina ghabhe bhala ahundwa kumi na abhili, ghwa ulongohi ndo Simoni ywakakemitwe Petili na Andelea nnongo ghwake, Yakobu mwana ghwa Sebedayu na Yohane nnongo ghwake,
Filipo na Batolomayu, Tomasi na Matayu ywakabheghite nsumula sumu na Yakobu mwana ywa Alufayu na Tadei,
Simoni mundu ywakatutanilite nnima ghwake Yuda Isikaliyote ywakankilukite Yesu.
Lihengo lya abho ahundwa kumi na abhili
Yesu kakialaghila abho kumi na abhili na kuapegha malagho, “Nkotoke kughenda kwa bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi, hangi nkotoke kuyingila mu kitami kyohele kya Akaasamalila.
Peni mbaha nngende kwa Akaisilaeli bhaahobhite handa mene.
Panng'enda mukalandamihe pannongela, ‘Ghubhutwa ghwa kunane ghuheghelela.’
Mualamihe atamwa, mukaahyuhe bhaahweghite, mubhayohe bhabheghite na maloha, mmuhe mandilu. Mpeghwa yaghi, na mwenga muapeghe yaghi.
Nkotoke kutola sahabu, ebu madini ghaakemwa fesa, ebu ngalabha mumihako ya mikungi yenu.
Nkotoke kutola nhako ghwa mu mwanja, ebu maghwanda mabhili, ebu makubasi ghangi, ebu nkongocho, kiyaha ntendalihengu kangunoghwa kukingama mulyo ghwake.”
“Pannyingila mu kitami ebu kijiji kyohele, mumpalahe mundu ywakapala kuakingama, na ntame kwa ywombe mbaka pampala kubhuka.
Pannyingila mu lubhagha, muajambuhe huti uhihimilo ghubheghe namwenga.
Handa abhegha bhandu bha maha munyumba ayi Chapanga kabhanonele. Peni handa abhegha ng'obhe bhandu bha maha, Chapanga kataanonela ng'obhe bhandu abho.
Handa mundu kanguakingama ng'obhe kubhayihwa mwenga. Basi, mpumunde lihu mumaghulu ghenu pammegha mu kubhuka mu nyumba ayo.
Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, linjubha lya toso, kitami akyo kyamokola kihyato kikulu kupitingana kila kyaakimokolite bhandu bha hitami hya Sodoma na Gomola.”
Kimbamanda kiipala kuhika
“Nnole nungualaghila handa mene munkati ya galu bha kunhitu. Hinu mmeghe na malango handa liyoka na apole handa ngunda.
Mulindakile na bhandu, kiyaha bhatabhayegha mu njengakaya yabhe na kuatuta mu nyumba hyabhe hya ngonganilo.
Maayeghwa kwa atabhala na abhatwa kwakya nenga, ngati mmokole muaghombele bhombe yakya nenga na kwa bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi.
Peni paabhayegha munjengakaya, nkotoke kuhwacha kya kulongela, kiyaha maapeghwa kya kulongela lisaa alyo alyo.
Mana chepa mwenga mumpala kulongela, ngati Nhuki ywa Tate ywenu kutalongela kupitila mwenga.”
“Nnongo katankiluka nnongo ywake kakomwe, na tate katankiluka mwana ywake, bhana bhataakiluka abhele bhabhe na kuatenda akomwe.
Bhandu bhataapala ng'obhe mwenga kwakya kuhyubhalila nenga. Peni yunakulimbilila mbaka kuuhiko aywo katalopohwa.
Bhandu paabhapamanda mukitami kimu nng'ende kitami kingi. Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, mayiyomola ng'obhe hitami hyoha hya ku Isilaeli kukali na kubhuya kwa Mwana ywa Mundu.”
“Nhundwa kaahotola ng'obhe kulikweha kwa nnhunda ywake ebu nndumitumi kaahotola ng'obhe kulikweha kwa bambo ywake.

Nhundwa kangunoghwa kubhegha handa nhunda ywake, na nndumindumi kangunoghwa kubhegha handa bambo ywake. Handa nenga ndo nkulu ywa nyumba yenu bhangungema Belisebuli, bhuli mwenga chepa bhaabhakema mahina mahakata kyanalumu!”
Ywakanoghwa kuyoghopwa
“Basi, nkotoke kubhayoghopa bhandu abho, kiyaha kahone kiigubikitwe kyene kyangagubutuligwa, na kila kiihihitwe kyaahumbulwa.
Linuaghombela mwenga mu mbwepo, mwenga mulilongele pakindandabhanji, na lila linubhapwepwela, mulilandamihe ngati kila mundu kaliyihwe.
Nkotoke kubhayoghopa bhala bhanakughukoma mmili peni bhaahotola kata kuukoma nhuki. Mungunoghwa munnyoghope Chapanga ywakahotola kughukanjaghana nhuki na mmili mu mwoto ghwa kumambe.
Bhuli, hidunduli abhili bhanguhemelwa ng'obhe kwa ligwala yimu ghweka? Peni kahone hata yumu ywabhe ywakapala kuponeka kyangali kummanya Tate ywenu.
Hata hwili hya mitwe hyenu Chapanga kahimanya mmalango ghwake.
Habhu nkotoke kuyoghopa, kiyaha mwenga bha maha muno muulongolo ghwa Chapanga kupitingana hidunduli atangalo.”
Kunnyitikila na kunkana Kilisto
“Mundu ywohele ywakanyitikila nenga muulongolo ghwa bhandu, na nenga ndannyitikila ywombe muulongolo ghwa Tate ywangu ywa kunane.
Peni ywohele ywakangana nenga mu ulongolo ghwa bhandu, na nenga ndankana mu ulongolo ghwa Tate ywangu ywa kunane.”
Nyegha ng'obhe uhihimilo ngati nyegha ngondo
“Nkotoke kuhwacha kukita nyegha uhihimilo mu nnima, nyegha ng'obhe uhihimilo ngati ngondo.
Kiyaha hika kuatenda tate na mwana ywake nnume abheghe amyanja, kangi nhinja na mama ywake abheghe amyanja, nakamwa na mama ywa nngwana ywake,
na amyanja bha mundu bhaabhegha bha mukaya yake.”

“Mundu ywohele ywakampala tate ywake ebu mama ywake kupitingana nenga, kangunoghwa ng'obhe kubhegha nhundwa ywangu. Na ywohele ywakampala mwana ywake ebu nhinja ywake kupitingana nenga, kangunoghwa ng'obhe kubhegha nhundwa ywa nenga.
Kangi mundu ywohele ywakatola ng'obhe lupingika lwake na kundughila, kangunoghwa ng'obhe kubhegha nhundwa ywanenga.
Ywombe ywakapala kuulamiha ubhumi ghwake kataghuhobheha, naywo ywombe ywakapala kuuhobheha ubhumi ghwake kwakya nenga kataulopoha.”
Bhaapala kukingama hupo
“Mundu ywohele ywakaatekula mwenga kangundekula nenga na ywohele kangundekula nenga, kanguntekula ywakalaghilite.
Mundu ywohele ywakantekula mbuye kiyaha aywo ndo mbuye, kaakingama hupo ya mbuye, na ywakantekula mundu ywa maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga, kaakingama hupo ya mundu ywa maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga.
Mundu ywohele ywakapala kumpegha nnobho ghwa machi, yumu ywa abha adoko kiyaha ndo ahundwa bhangu, kulyaghila nunguaghombela, katapeghwa hupo yake.”
